description: Source code for managing WiFi steering clients web configuration, including encoding, decoding, and translation of steering client data in JSON format.

methods.name: init_steering_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Initializes the steering clients sub-document with predefined objects.

methods.name: access_check_steering_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Performs access check for steering clients sub-document.

methods.name: translate_from_steering_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Translates steering clients sub-document data to OVSDB or TR181 formats based on descriptor.

methods.name: translate_to_steering_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Translates steering clients sub-document data from OVSDB or TR181 formats based on descriptor.

methods.name: free_steering_client_entries
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for steering client entries in sub-document data.

methods.name: encode_steering_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Encodes steering clients data into JSON format for web configuration.

methods.name: decode_steering_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into steering clients sub-document data structure.
